user.title: Smart Ventilation
user.description: What would you like to set up?

menu_option_descriptions.room: Set up sensors, windows and behaviour for one room.
menu_option_descriptions.overview: Most urgent room and one combined notification for all rooms.

room.title: Set up room
room.description: The first three sections contain the required settings. Everything else can be changed later via “Configure”.

room.name: Room & windows
room.description: How large is the room and which windows belong to it?

data_description.name: Used in notifications and as device name, e.g. “Bedroom”.
data_description.window: One or more contacts. Two or more open at the same time are detected as cross ventilation and learned separately.
data_description.volume: Floor area × ceiling height, e.g. 16 m² × 2.5 m = 40 m³. Used for heat loss and costs.
data_description.window_direction: Direction the window faces: 0° north, 90° east, 180° south, 270° west.
data_description.room_type: Just a suggestion: pre-fills the daily humidity target when setting up the room, unless you change it yourself.

indoor.name: Sensors in the room
indoor.description: Readings from the room. CO₂ and shower are optional.

data_description.indoor_absolute_humidity: Sensor with the absolute humidity in the room (g/m³).
data_description.co2_sensor: Optional. Ventilation is also recommended above 1000 ppm.
data_description.shower_sensor: Optional, for bathrooms: immediate hint after showering, reminder after 30 minutes if still humid.
data_description.shower_detect: For bathrooms without a shower sensor: detects a fast humidity rise (+1.5 g/m³ within 10 minutes).

outdoor.name: Outdoor & weather
outdoor.description: Readings from outside – e.g. from your weather station.

data_description.rain: Binary sensor or rain rate in mm/h. No ventilation is recommended while it rains.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. With an hourly forecast the best ventilation time and a summer night-cooling plan are calculated.

behavior.name: Ventilation behaviour
behavior.description: When to ventilate, cool down or warn.

data_description.season_mode: Winter: short burst ventilation, never tilted windows. Summer: no ventilation when it is warmer outside; cooling by ventilation possible. With "Automatic", calendar month, a multi-day weather forecast trend (if a weather entity is selected) and otherwise outdoor temperature decide – a change based on outdoor temperature only takes effect after several hours of a sustained trend, so the mode does not keep flipping back and forth.
data_description.target_absolute_humidity: Once the indoor absolute humidity drops below this while venting, the day counts as sufficiently aired. The room type above suggests a matching value when setting up.
data_description.max_temperature_difference: Do not ventilate if it is warmer outside than inside by more than this.
data_description.comfort_temperature: If it is warmer inside and at least 2 °C cooler outside, ventilating to cool down is recommended.
data_description.preheat_temperature: If the room is below this temperature and it is at least 2 °C warmer outside than inside, ventilation to preheat the room is recommended after a night with values below the heating threshold, to delay active heating. Based on the actual overnight low, not the (deliberately slow-reacting) summer/winter mode above – preheating only stays off when that mode is manually set to "summer".
data_description.cool_limit: Warns when the room gets colder than this while a window is open. 0 = off.
data_description.building_standard: Determines the estimated temperature at the coldest wall spot and therefore the mould risk.
data_description.humidity_hysteresis: How much conditions must clearly improve before an active "vent due to humidity" recommendation switches off again. Higher = steadier but reacts a bit slower; lower = reacts faster but can flicker more with noisy sensors.

notify.name: Notifications
notify.description: Who is informed when, reports and vacation.

data_description.notify_services: Phones with the Home Assistant app. Nothing selected = no push notifications.
data_description.persons: Optional. Reminders only to people at home, a hint on arrival and a warning when everyone left with a window open.
data_description.quiet_start: No ventilation reminders. Warnings (cooling, window open, after showering) are still sent.
data_description.weekly_report: A summary of the week on Sundays at 7 pm.
data_description.monthly_report: On the 1st of each month: summary of the previous month compared to the month before and – from the second year – to the previous year.
data_description.vacation_entity: Optional: calendar, switch or binary sensor. No reminders during vacation, only mould warnings.
data_description.vacation_keyword: Only events containing this word count as vacation. Empty = every event.

devices.name: Heating & devices
devices.description: Optional: thermostats, dehumidifier and cost estimate.

data_description.climate_entities: Optional. Off or minimum after 1 minute with an open window, restored afterwards. Leave empty if your thermostats have their own open-window detection.
data_description.dehumidifier_entity: Optional: switch or dehumidifier. Runs when it is humid and ventilating is not possible right now.
data_description.energy_price: For the cost estimate, e.g. gas ≈ 0.12 €/kWh, heat pump ≈ 0.10 €/kWh.

advanced.name: Fine-tuning
advanced.description: Rarely needed – the defaults suit most homes.

data.wind_is_from: Wind direction is where the wind comes from

data_description.season_threshold: Automatic mode only: outdoor temperature below which winter mode applies (heating limit, usually 15 °C).
data_description.notification_cooldown: The next ventilation reminder is sent at the earliest after this time.
data_description.wind_is_from: Usual for weather stations: 270° = wind from the west. Turn off only if your sensor reports the direction it blows to.
data_description.use_sun: If the sun shines directly on the window, the ventilation time is limited.
data_description.min_sun_elevation: Below this the sun does not count as shining directly.

overview.title: Overview of all rooms
overview.description: Shows the most urgent room and combines reminders and weekly reports of all rooms into one notification.

messages.name: Notifications
messages.description: One combined notification for all rooms.

data_description.combine_notifications: One notification for all rooms instead of one per room.
data_description.notify_services: Phones with the Home Assistant app. Nothing selected = no push notifications.
data_description.persons: Optional. Reminders only to people at home, a hint on arrival and a warning when everyone left with a window open.
data_description.quiet_start: No ventilation reminders. Warnings (cooling, window open, after showering) are still sent.
data_description.notification_cooldown: The next ventilation reminder is sent at the earliest after this time.

reports.name: Reports
reports.description: Weekly and monthly summary of all rooms.

data_description.weekly_report: A summary of the week on Sundays at 7 pm.
data_description.monthly_report: On the 1st of each month: summary of the previous month compared to the month before and – from the second year – to the previous year.

sensor_unavailable.title: Smart Ventilation: sensor missing ({room})
sensor_unavailable.description:
The sensor **{role}** (`{entity}`) in **{room}** has not reported values for at least {minutes} minutes. Without it the ventilation recommendation cannot be calculated.

Check whether the device is reachable (battery, radio) or pick another sensor under *Devices & services → Smart Ventilation → Configure*. This notice disappears automatically once values arrive again.

status.name: Ventilation status
status.description: Tells whether and where to ventilate (also for Assist and automations).
